It neither implements nor tests Dream–LoRA–Think.
system_thesis: Dream–LoRA–Think is a recurrent complete organism: lived action/outcome episodes yield grounded evidence; DREAM later and without the future goal grows local candidate connections and re-expressions; independent later evidence supports or revokes them; SLEEP transactionally consolidates only validated personal semantics through parametric/LoRA transport; THINK retrieves, composes, plans, acts, observes, and revises under a released goal; and later thinking/outcomes can become eligible for future dream cycles. V9 is not that organism. It is solely a governance-bound precursor for a finite, supplied-memory relay instrument. A future relay result could credit a fixed policy's use of supplied public memory, never discovery by DREAM, transport by LoRA, or behavior of the whole organism.
